key_insight: Knowledge graphs help medicine connect scattered clinical and biomedical information so AI systems can reason more semantically and provide more interpretable support across several healthcare tasks.
clinical_relevance: The paper suggests KGs may improve decision support, prediction, recommendation, precision medicine, and question answering by making patient- and disease-specific relationships easier to use.
method: Build medical KGs from EHRs, clinical notes, literature, and web resources
Use ontologies, semantic web methods, and information extraction to structure relationships
Combine deep learning with symbolic reasoning in hybrid neuro-symbolic pipelines
evidence_signal: This is a survey that reviews current research, comparing architectures, trends, and evaluation practices across five major application areas and KG-generation methods.
watch_item: A major concern is that current KGs can have incomplete coverage and integration issues across heterogeneous sources, which can limit reliability and fairness.
paper_title: Semantic Reasoning in Medicine: The Role of Knowledge Graphs Across Five Key Domains
